items.title: Bill Kirchner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2021
items.q: Oh, Dave and I are both from Youngstown, Ohio.

ctx.x: Ut uh. I can’t write on the computer. I mean I know a number of composers and arrangers who are like me, who have just never made the transition.
